question: Among all superheroes published by Dark Horse Comics, identify those who have more than 15 superpowers. For these heroes, return their full names and the percentage they represent of all superheroes in the database.

prediction.sql:
WITH QualifyingHeroes AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_018 AS hero_id, s.XCL_020 AS full_name
    FROM superhero AS s
    INNER JOIN publisher AS p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    INNER JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
    WHERE p.XCL_015 = 'Dark Horse Comics'
    GROUP BY s.XCL_018, s.XCL_020
    HAVING COUNT(hp.XCL_013) > 15
),
TotalHeroes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(XCL_018) AS total_count FROM superhero
)
SELECT q.full_name,
       (CAST(COUNT(q.hero_id) AS REAL) * 100 / t.total_count) AS percentage
FROM QualifyingHeroes AS q
CROSS JOIN TotalHeroes AS t
GROUP BY q.full_name, t.total_count

WITH QualifyingHeroes AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_018 AS hero_id, s.XCL_020 AS full_name
    FROM superhero AS s
    INNER JOIN publisher AS p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    INNER JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
    WHERE p.XCL_015 = 'Dark Horse Comics'
    GROUP BY s.XCL_018, s.XCL_020
    HAVING COUNT(hp.XCL_013) > 15
),
TotalHeroes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(XCL_018) AS total_count FROM superhero
)
SELECT q.full_name,
       (CAST(COUNT(q.hero_id) AS REAL) * 100 / t.total_count) AS percentage
FROM QualifyingHeroes AS q
CROSS JOIN TotalHeroes AS t
GROUP BY q.full_name, t.total_count
